rows.title_full:
AN ACT SIMPLIFYING THE PROCEDURE IN THE DISPOSITION OF
PUBLIC AGRICULTURAL LANDS, AMENDING FOR THE
PURPOSE SECTION 24 OF COMMONWEALTH ACT NO. 141,
OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE “PUBLIC LAND ACT”
rows.title_short:
Simplifying The Procedure In The Disposition Of
Public Agricultural Lands, Amending For The
Purpose Section 24 Of Commonwealth Act No. 141,
Otherwise Known As The “ Public Land Act”
rows.abstract:
Seeks to simplify and update the publication requirements in the disposition of public agricultural lands under Commonwealth Act No. 141 and shortens the announcement of sale by publishing the proper notice once a week from six (6) to two (2) consecutive weeks.
Removes the option of publishing the notice in Spanish or in the local dialect and increases the threshold of the land value that will require publication in the Official Gazette from Two Hundred Forty Pesos (P240.00) to Fifty Thousand Pesos (P50,000.00).
rows.status: Approved by the House on 2023-08-02, transmitted to the Senate on 2023-08-03 and received by the Senate on 2023-08-03

rows.title_full:
AN ACT ESTABLISHING SPECIALTY CENTERS IN HOSPITALS UNDER THE DIRECT
SUPERVISION AND CONTROL OF THE DEPARTMENT OF HEALTH, AND
APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.title_short: Department Of Health Specialty Centers Act
rows.abstract:
Seeks to establish specialty centers in select hospitals under the direct supervision of the Department of Health (DOH) and shall prioritize for seventeen (17) specialty care including cancer care, cardiovascular care, lung care, renal care and kidney transplant, brain and spine care, trauma care, burn care, orthopedic care, physical rehabilitation medicine, infectious disease and tropical medicine, toxicology, mental health, geriatric care, neonatal care, dermatology care, ear, nose and throat care and eye care.
Mandates the DOH to include the establishment of specialty center in the Philippine Health Facility Development Plan (PHFDP) which shall serve as a guide for investments funded by the national government to rationalize the distribution of capacity and capability of health facilities.
Provides at least one (1) specialty center in every region within five (5) years upon the effectivity of this Act based on the top burden of disease and special needs in the area.
rows.status: Republic Act RA11959 enacted on 2023-08-24

rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR A NATIONAL DIGITAL TRANSFORMATION POLICY AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract:
Seeks to ensure that every citizen will have an opportunity to understand ICT and develop the necessary skills for the digital age by providing a national framework for digital transformation with the adoption of information and communications technology (ICT) and digital competency in all forms of learning, and a national digital transformation and skills developments strategy.
Proposes several provisions as follows:  Digital Competence Framework for Citizens; ICT Competency Framework for Teachers; National Digital Transformation Strategy; Digital Inclusion; Digital Libraries and Learning flute; Digital Entrepreneurship; Digital Civil Service; Nat´l Digital Skills Dev´t Strategy; Digital Jobs; and Nat´l Digital Transformation Council.
